about.hero_lead: We are designers, engineers, AI specialists and SEO professionals working as a single team — to build digital products that move real numbers, not just look good in a portfolio.
about.story_heading: We started Eserve Infotech to make software companies actually want to work with.
about.story_p1: Most agencies treat clients like tickets. We don't. From the first call we behave like an internal team — short meetings, weekly demos, real ownership of outcomes.
about.story_p2: We are headquartered in Croydon, serve clients across the UK and Europe, and lean on a global delivery network for senior engineering and design talent. Our work spans marketing sites, mobile apps, AI assistants, ERP/CRM systems and the SEO that makes them found.
about.principle_1_text: We measure ourselves on the metric that matters to your business — not lines of code.
about.principle_2_text: Weekly demos, working software, screen-recordings. No black boxes, no surprises.
about.principle_3_text: Every engagement is led by senior craft. We don't farm out junior work and call it an agency.
about.principle_4_text: Speed, accessibility and Core Web Vitals are part of the brief, not an afterthought.
about.principle_5_text: Analytics, observability, backups, docs. The unglamorous stuff that keeps you safe.
about.principle_6_text: We're built for multi-year partnerships, not one-and-done launches.

svc_web_dev.hero_lead: From marketing sites to multi-tenant web apps and headless commerce, we build fast, accessible, conversion-tuned products on modern stacks.
svc_web_dev.feat_1_desc: Brand-first sites that load fast, rank well and convert visitors into customers.
svc_web_dev.feat_2_desc: Dashboards, portals and SaaS apps tailored to your processes — built to scale.
svc_web_dev.feat_3_desc: Shopify Hydrogen, BigCommerce, custom carts — split front-end from store for speed.
svc_web_dev.feat_4_desc: WordPress, Sanity, Strapi, Contentful — let your team publish without engineering.
svc_web_dev.feat_5_desc: Core Web Vitals, image optimisation, caching, edge delivery — top 10% of Lighthouse.
svc_web_dev.feat_6_desc: Inclusive by default. Audited, screen-reader friendly and keyboard navigable.
svc_web_dev.step_1_desc: Audit current site, map user journeys, define KPIs and success criteria.
svc_web_dev.step_2_desc: Tokens, components, prototypes — reviewed live and signed off in Figma.
svc_web_dev.step_3_desc: Component-driven build, weekly demos, staging environment, CI/CD pipelines.
svc_web_dev.step_4_desc: Analytics, A/B testing, SEO and ongoing performance optimisation.
svc_web_dev.faq_1_q: Can you redesign and replatform an existing site?
svc_web_dev.faq_1_a: Yes — that's a sizeable chunk of our work. We migrate content, preserve SEO equity and run before/after benchmarks.
svc_web_dev.faq_2_a: We do. Custom themes, headless WordPress and ACF-powered builders. We also migrate away from WordPress when it's the right call.
svc_web_dev.faq_3_q: How fast will my site be?
svc_web_dev.faq_3_a: We target Lighthouse 95+ on mobile and Core Web Vitals 'Good' on real devices. Performance is part of the brief.
svc_web_dev.cta_lead: Bring us a brief, or just a problem.
svc_web_dev.cta_p: One call, one written next step. No pressure, no jargon.

svc_mobile.hero_lead: iOS, Android and cross-platform apps with native-feel UX, reliable backends and the boring infrastructure that keeps them running.
svc_mobile.feat_1_desc: Swift / SwiftUI and Kotlin / Jetpack Compose for performance-critical experiences.
svc_mobile.feat_2_desc: React Native and Flutter when you need one codebase across iOS, Android and tablet.
svc_mobile.feat_3_desc: APIs, auth, real-time sync, payments, push notifications, analytics — handled end to end.
svc_mobile.feat_4_desc: Interactive prototypes, micro-interactions, motion specs aligned with iOS HIG and Material 3.
svc_mobile.feat_5_desc: We ship to the App Store and Play Store, handle review, deep links, and app sizes.
svc_mobile.feat_6_desc: Crash reporting, A/B tests, feature flags, OTA updates, monthly improvement cycles.
svc_mobile.step_1_desc: Audience research, platform choice, monetisation model and KPI tree.
svc_mobile.step_2_desc: Interactive Figma prototype on real device for stakeholder validation.
svc_mobile.step_3_desc: Modular architecture, automated tests, instrumented analytics from day one.
svc_mobile.step_4_desc: Store launch, marketing site, growth experiments and crash-free release cadence.
svc_mobile.faq_1_a: Depends on your team and product. We share trade-offs honestly and let you choose. Most consumer apps land on React Native; high-perf apps go native.
svc_mobile.faq_2_a: Yes — most engagements include UX, motion and visual design. We also work alongside your existing design team.
svc_mobile.faq_3_a: Typically 8–14 weeks for a focused MVP, including backend and store submission.
svc_mobile.cta_lead: Bring us a brief, or just a problem.
svc_mobile.cta_p: One call, one written next step. No pressure, no jargon.

svc_ai.hero_lead: RAG copilots, document intelligence, automation agents and custom LLM workflows — grounded in your data, evaluated on real tasks.
svc_ai.feat_1_desc: Internal copilots that answer from your docs, tickets, wiki and Slack — with citations.
svc_ai.feat_2_desc: Extract structure from invoices, contracts, forms and emails. JSON in, decisions out.
svc_ai.feat_3_desc: Multi-step agents that draft, route, summarise and act inside your existing tools.
svc_ai.feat_4_desc: Prompt orchestration, evaluation harnesses, guardrails, tool-use, function calling.
svc_ai.feat_5_desc: Whisper-powered transcription, voice notes, real-time translation, call summarisation.
svc_ai.feat_6_desc: Test sets, regression tracking, PII handling, prompt injection defences.
svc_ai.step_1_desc: Identify the highest-value tasks and define what 'good enough' looks like.
svc_ai.step_2_desc: Index your data; build an evaluation set so improvements are measurable.
svc_ai.step_3_desc: Ship a working v1 in weeks, not quarters. Iterate against the eval set.
svc_ai.step_4_desc: Logging, observability, cost controls, prompt-versioning, ongoing tuning.
svc_ai.faq_1_q: Will my data be used to train models?
svc_ai.faq_1_a: No. We default to providers and configurations where customer data is not used for training, and self-host models when policy requires it.
svc_ai.faq_2_a: Retrieval grounding, function-calling, structured outputs, confidence thresholds and human-in-the-loop on high-stakes actions.
svc_ai.faq_3_a: Yes — we deploy open models (Llama, Mistral) on AWS, Azure or your own VPC when data residency demands it.
svc_ai.cta_h2: Bring us a brief, or just a problem.
svc_ai.cta_p: One call, one written next step. No pressure, no jargon.

svc_seo.hero_lead: Technical SEO, programmatic content, link earning, GEO for AI search, and conversion optimisation — the full growth stack, measured weekly.
svc_seo.feat_1_desc: Crawl, index, Core Web Vitals, schema, hreflang, log-file analysis. Every blocker uncovered.
svc_seo.feat_2_desc: Topical clusters, briefs, editorial workflows. We hire and brief the writers if you need.
svc_seo.feat_3_desc: Pages-at-scale built on real data, with thin-content safeguards and proper internal linking.
svc_seo.feat_4_desc: Optimisation for ChatGPT search, AI Overviews, Perplexity. llms.txt and citation-ready content.
svc_seo.feat_5_desc: Digital PR, data studies, expert quotes, partnerships. Real links from real publications.
svc_seo.feat_6_desc: GA4, Mixpanel, Hotjar, A/B testing — convert the traffic you already have.
svc_seo.step_1_desc: Technical, content and competitor audits. A clear, prioritised punch list.
svc_seo.step_2_desc: Fix indexability, schema, sitemaps, IA. The boring stuff that unlocks growth.
svc_seo.step_3_desc: Content engine launches: research, briefs, drafts, publishing, internal linking.
svc_seo.step_4_desc: Monthly optimisation cycles, weekly reporting, quarterly strategy reviews.
svc_seo.faq_1_q: How long until we see results?
svc_seo.faq_1_a: Foundational fixes can move pages in weeks. Compounding wins typically show by month 3–6 and accelerate from there.
svc_seo.faq_2_a: No reputable agency does. We guarantee process: audits, fixes, content velocity and weekly reporting against agreed KPIs.
svc_seo.faq_3_q: Do you also do paid search?
svc_seo.faq_3_a: Yes — paid search and paid social work alongside SEO when conversion data is needed quickly.
svc_seo.cta_lead: Bring us a brief, or just a problem.
svc_seo.cta_p: One call, one written next step. No pressure, no jargon.

svc_erp.hero_h1_part2: your business, not the other way around.
svc_erp.hero_lead: Custom ERP, CRM and operations dashboards. Replace fragile spreadsheets and over-priced SaaS with software shaped to how you actually work.
svc_erp.feat_1_desc: Pipelines, deals, contacts and reporting tailored to how your sales team actually sells.
svc_erp.feat_2_desc: Inventory, purchase orders, manufacturing, finance, payroll — built modular, deployed phased.
svc_erp.feat_3_desc: Real-time KPIs across sales, ops and finance. Single source of truth for the leadership team.
svc_erp.feat_4_desc: Stripe, Xero, Sage, QuickBooks, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, Mailchimp — and your bespoke APIs.
svc_erp.feat_5_desc: Fine-grained permissions, audit logs, SSO, MFA. Compliance-ready out of the box.
svc_erp.feat_6_desc: Data migration from legacy systems, workshops, video docs, and a 60-day hyper-care period.
svc_erp.step_1_desc: Map your processes, pain points and the people doing the work today.
svc_erp.step_2_desc: An architectural plan with phases, integrations, costs and risks — signed off.
svc_erp.step_3_desc: Ship the highest-leverage module first; replace the most painful spreadsheet.
svc_erp.step_4_desc: Migrate, train, support. Then iterate phase 2 once phase 1 is bedded in.
svc_erp.faq_1_a: Off-the-shelf is right when your processes are common. Custom wins when your edge is operational and the licence cost or rigidity hurts.
svc_erp.faq_2_q: Can you integrate with our existing systems?
svc_erp.faq_2_a: Yes. We build on top of, alongside or as a replacement for existing ERPs, CRMs, accounting and ecommerce platforms.
svc_erp.faq_3_a: Scripted, tested, dry-run, then cut-over with rollback. We never trust a 'big bang' migration.
svc_erp.cta_h2: Bring us a brief, or just a problem.
svc_erp.cta_p: One call, one written next step. No pressure, no jargon.
